New Construction · April Johnson

Buyer representation for new construction in Phenix City and Columbus

A new home can leave you with a different set of questions. What is included? Which decisions still need to be made? How will the expected completion date fit your move?

I work with buyers interested in new construction throughout my East Alabama and West Georgia service markets.

Discuss a new-construction purchase ↗

Start with the home and the details you need

Bring the community name, property address or builder information you have. Tell me whether you are considering an available home or a home that has not been completed.

If you are still searching, share your preferred location and property requirements. Visit the property search to begin exploring.

Get your questions in order

Features and selections

Write down which features matter most to you. Ask what the quoted price includes, what is optional and where those details are recorded.

Timing and your next move

Share your intended move date and any property you need to sell. Ask which dates are estimates and what happens if plans change.

Representation and agreements

Tell me where you are in the process, including whether you have visited a builder or signed anything. We can discuss the representation available for your situation.

Ask about the new home you are considering ↗

Keep the whole purchase in view

New construction is one part of my buyer representation work. If the purchase also involves a sale, explore selling your current home. If you want to buy land first, visit land and acreage.

Bring the unanswered questions

You do not need to have selected a builder to reach out. Tell me your preferred area, timing and the decisions you need help organizing.

A question is a good place to start.

Tell me what you are considering and what you need to understand.

Have a question about your own situation?

Ask April ↗
Does April work with new-construction buyers in Phenix City?

Yes. New-construction buyer representation is part of my real estate practice in my Alabama and Georgia service markets.

Can I speak with April before visiting a builder?

Yes. Tell me which builder or property you are considering so we can discuss your questions and representation before you take the next step.

What if I have already visited a new-home community?

Tell me what you have visited and whether you have signed any documents. We can discuss your position and the next questions to address.

Are builder incentives available?

Ask for the current written details for the specific property. Send me the home or community you are considering so we can discuss the questions you want answered.

Can April help if I need to sell before buying new construction?

Yes. I work with both buyers and sellers. Tell me about the property you own and your purchase plans so we can discuss the timing together.

Let’s start with you

What would you like to do next?

Buying, selling, or working out how to do both. Bring your questions.
